quote: Well, good point. In the wintertime, it has gone to $500 a month.
stewart_read: Strong bill pain surfaced ($500/mo winter, $3,500-4,000/yr) but rep only acknowledges and files it rather than flipping it into emotional leverage.
coaching_implication: Rep should have said something like 'that's exactly the kind of bill our program is designed to eliminate' to tie the pain to urgency before moving to qualifiers.

quote: Well, actually, the house is in a partnership with my sister and me, but I'm the general partner, the one who runs everything.
stewart_read: A co-owner was identified but never surfaced again for appointment inclusion; rep treated Robert as sole decision-maker.
alternative_hypothesis: Robert stated he 'runs everything' as general partner, so rep may have reasonably judged sister's presence unnecessary — but this wasn't confirmed, just assumed.
coaching_implication: Rep should explicitly ask whether the sister needs to be part of the appointment given her title stake, even if Robert self-describes as decision-maker.

quote: all we ask of the homeowner is you just have a credit score of at least 670. Is that gonna be an issue for you at all?
stewart_read: Correct threshold stated per schema (670), cleanly delivered with no drift.
coaching_implication: No coaching needed here; this is the model phrasing.

quote: Would it be easier if we could just read off those numbers to me?
stewart_read: Rep pivoted immediately to a verbal read-back when the customer had a printed bill rather than a digital copy, avoiding a time-burn on a photo/text path.
coaching_implication: This is a positive pattern worth reinforcing floor-wide — fast pivot to an alternate bill-capture path.

quote: Well and, yeah, I'm in, Virginia Eastern Standard Time, so I don't know what code, time zone you are in.
stewart_read: Rep handled the timezone/location question transparently, explaining the Utah office and Virginia local presence rather than dodging or fabricating.
coaching_implication: Good transparent handling; no correction needed, though the tangent about being '90 miles away' was unnecessary filler.

stewart_read: A $4,313 kWh reading in November plus December/January/February all above 2,400 kWh shows a heavy, consistent usage pattern well beyond average — strong solar fit signal.
coaching_implication: Rep captured the numbers but never verbally flagged the high winter spike back to the customer as a selling point for the appointment.
